contract_invariants.posting_idempotency_key: trimmed; 8-100 characters; missing or blank=428; out of range=422
contract_invariants.request_hash: canonical JSON/query SHA-256 v2; v2 comparison ignores legacy MD5 suffix differences
contract_invariants.atomicity: business stock write and persisted response snapshot commit or rollback together
contract_invariants.authoritative_posting_boundary: receipt/issue re-lock current stock document and line with lockForUpdate at the stock-effect boundary; stale approved models cannot mutate balance or movement
contract_invariants.double_post: one document transition and one movement business key effect
contract_invariants.formal_status: PROPOSED until BA, FE1 and QA2 independently sign the same exact SHA and artifact digest

ci.credential_policy: passwords are runtime-only GitHub Actions secrets; no password is committed in the workflow, Postman collection or environment

reviewers.BA: G1 decision and minutes on WWHN-40/WWHN-181/WWHN-183
reviewers.FE1: endpoint, payload, error and permission mapping on the same exact SHA and artifact digest
reviewers.QA2: independent exact-SHA API, DB, race, timeout-after-commit and reconciliation retest on WWHN-182
reviewers.BE1: implementation and artifact owner; BE1 self-review is not independent sign-off

known_external_blockers.detail: Atlassian Rovo returned HTTP 403: app is not installed on the Jira instance; closure comment and G1 minutes cannot be posted by this execution.
No GitHub Actions status/run was observed for the latest direct m1 commit. A manual workflow_dispatch or a push actor that triggers Actions is required before using an evidence artifact.
BA, FE1 and QA2 must independently review the same exact commit SHA and verified artifact digest.

approval.rule: Do not mark APPROVED, Done or 100% until BA, FE1 and QA2 comments reference the same exact commit SHA and a verified SHA256SUMS digest from a successful workflow artifact.
